messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: R2 (R square) on regression models
parts:
Currently, brms does not support R2. The reason is that the models, for which R2 is canonically defined (i.e. linear models), are just a special case of the large class of multilevel models brms supports.

For an implementation of R2 to make sense in brms, I needed an R2 method widely applicable to most (generalized) multilevel models. I am aware some R2 methods for mulitlevel models, but I didn't dive deep enough yet to evaluate which of them (if any) does make sense in the context of brms. I am open to suggestions though.
